acceptance_predicates.description: handoffctl exposes a revision-fenced accept command for validated task acceptance.
Invalid owner, status, revision, spec, evidence class, reference, or digest is rejected without metadata mutation.
The repair changes only downstream-owned coordinator integration and does not modify vendored v0.3.59 bytes.

definition_of_done: Positive and negative acceptance-command tests pass.
Independent review, exact-head CI, signed merge, and post-merge doctor pass.

inputs.description: ASB state repository with exact Agent Workflow Coordinator v0.3.59 vendor snapshot.
A task with matching spec_ref and spec_revision.

outputs.description: Supported handoffctl mutation for canonical spec_acceptance metadata.

gates.description: The command records exact acceptance and rejects all malformed or stale inputs.
Vendor integrity, state quality, review, and exact-head gates remain green.
